doc: Fable v17 P1/P2 (G81): closed vocabulary of the six-slot situation template <WHO, WHAT, WHERE, HOW, UNTIL, WHY>, drawn from the existing vocabulary (O0 roles, the action binder of the prior families, the stop set, the colour roles). WHY is free prose. 'unspecified' = the line (or the pairs) do not fix the slot.

WHO.odd_object: the one object that differs from the others (odd one out)
WHO.exemplar: a template / multicolour exemplar / legend shape whose pattern is reused
WHO.same_colour_pair: pairs or groups of objects sharing a colour
WHO.colour_class: the objects of one colour role (most / least frequent, new colour, marker colour)
WHO.frame_or_container: a frame, box or container object and its interior
WHO.separator: separator lines and the panels they cut
WHO.region: a marked or framed area of the grid

WHAT.draw_line: draw rays / beams / lines (incl. connecting lines)
WHAT.recolour: change the colour of existing cells or objects
WHAT.copy_stamp: copy, stamp or replicate a shape or pattern
WHAT.mirror_complete: complete or extend by symmetry / reflection
WHAT.transform: rotate, flip, reorient or stretch shapes
WHAT.extract: crop / extract a part of the grid as the output
WHAT.tile_scale: tile, scale or repeat the grid or a unit
WHAT.summarise: output a small grid that summarises counts / properties
WHAT.complete_shape: complete partial shapes from an exemplar or a pattern
WHAT.decorate: add decoration (outline, halo, markers) around objects

WHERE.adjacent: next to / around / on the sides of the object
WHERE.on_line_of_sight: along the row / column / diagonal from the object
WHERE.aligned: on the row or column shared with another object
WHERE.mirror_position: at the mirror image position across an axis
WHERE.toward: in the direction of another object or edge
WHERE.across_separator: in the corresponding place across a separator / in another panel

HOW.other_object_colour: in the colour of a marker / exemplar / other participant
HOW.mapped_colour: by a colour mapping / legend / table
HOW.new_colour: in a colour that is new (not in the input)

UNTIL.obstacle: until it meets another object / colour
UNTIL.length_of_template: as long as a reference length / template
UNTIL.fixpoint: repeatedly until nothing changes / as much as possible
UNTIL.count: a fixed or counted number of times
